topic_title: Dangers of Speed and Street Racing Statutes
prompt: What mandatory law enforcement action applies to vehicles used in illegal Texas street racing events?

The vehicle title is transferred automatically to the local high school auto shop
The vehicle is seized and impounded by law enforcement at the owner's expense
The vehicle engine is inspected for horsepower without legal impoundment
